title: Google band, Tanya ka rasta!
format: Map journey: Tanya in her living room guides Myra by phone with landmark directions, cut between the live map and the room, ends at the front door
idea: Myra is driving to her first kitty; Tanya makes her switch off Google and gives landmark directions (bada ped, Gupta ji ki chai ki dukaan, Sharma ji ki laal gaadi), every landmark has moved or closed, and Google gets her there in two minutes.
logline: Tanya makes Myra switch off Google and guides her by landmarks that no longer exist, until Myra lands on the highway, turns Google back on and reaches the door in two minutes.
game: every landmark Tanya gives is gone, moved or everywhere

experiment.hook: Tanya in her living room on the phone, palm up like a traffic cop, Ruhi rolling her eyes beside her: 'Myra, Google band kar! Galat le jaata hai, main batati hoon.' chip MYRA KI PEHLI KITTY, clock 4:05
experiment.variable: a new map story that is not about a late friend: the auntie habit of landmark directions over the phone, written in the new flowing-conversation style (12-15 word exchanges, reactions, overlaps) at about 40 s
experiment.hypothesis: skip under 37% like the two posted map reels (36.8%, 38.8%) and watched above 30%; a habit every viewer has suffered plus 'Tag the friend jo landmark se rasta batati hai' gets 2+ shares

mute: Tanya on the phone in her living room, chip MYRA KI PEHLI KITTY 4:05: she tells Myra to switch off Google
Myra in her car with keys, nodding: 'band kar diya', Tanya says big tree then left
map: the dot leaves home and there are trees everywhere; Myra: 'har mod pe ped hai!'
Ruhi teases Tanya about the dog under the tree; Tanya hushes her and gives the chai shop
map: the dot reaches a building, Myra: 'yahan toh bank hai', Ruhi: 'woh dukaan band ho gayi'
Tanya shrugs it off: follow Sharma ji's red car; Myra happy: 'Mil gayi!'
map: the dot rushes off the edge with a car, chip SHARMA JI KE PEECHE, 'gaadi toh highway pe chadh gayi!'
Ruhi grabs the phone from Tanya: 'Google chala. Abhi.'
map: the dot slides straight to the pink K pin, chip GOOGLE: 2 MINUTE
front door, clock 5:10, Myra worn out with keys; Tanya proud: Google se aati toh aur ghoomna padta
beats: hook: Tanya bans Google, 'main batati hoon' / setup: Myra's first kitty, she obeys / esc: bada ped (every corner has one), Gupta ji ki chai (now a bank), Sharma ji ki laal gaadi (drives onto the highway) / turn: Ruhi grabs the phone, Google says 2 minute / button: Tanya flips her opening, 'Google se aati toh aur ghoomna padta!'

review.notes: Last 4 gang reels with a type were door-arrivals (26-b), countdown (26-a), meme-format (25-b), types-of (25-a), so map-journey, the best of the other types on data (skip 36.8% and 38.8%). Lead Myra (last reel Tanya); Tanya and Ruhi talk to her on the phone, 3 characters in all. No bank idea fits a map, so a new evergreen one was added and used: landmark directions are something every viewer has lived. Written to the 2026-11-26 human bar: each line answers the last (Myra's naive 'Ab bataiye?', Ruhi's teasing 'Kutta bhi roz jagah badalta hai', Tanya's 'Haan toh?'), claim before reveal on 'Mil gayi! Peeche peeche aa rahi hoon' then the highway, small true details (kutta under the tree, Gupta ji ki dukaan band do saal pehle, Sharma ji ki laal gaadi). Endings tried: Myra stays outside and the gang comes down to her (weak, loses the door), Tanya offers to guide the next kitty and everyone shouts 'Google!' (chorus, slogan-like), Tanya flips her own hook line and takes credit (kept, loops to the start). Two punchlines only. About 125 words, no line over 12 words, no shot over 8 s.

caption: Har group mein ek Tanya hoti hai jo Google se better rasta batati hai. Bada ped, chai ki dukaan, laal gaadi... Tag your Tanya!

lines.text: Myra, Google band kar! Galat le jaata hai, main batati hoon.
lines.say: मायरा, गूगल बंद कर! गलत ले जाता है, मैं बताती हूँ।

lines.text: Achha, band kar diya. Ab bataiye?
lines.say: अच्छा, बंद कर दिया। अब बताइए?

lines.text: Seedha aa, phir bade ped ke baad left.
lines.say: सीधा आ, फिर बड़े पेड़ के बाद लेफ्ट।

lines.text: Bada ped? Yahan toh har mod pe ped hai!
lines.say: बड़ा पेड़? यहाँ तो हर मोड़ पे पेड़ है!

lines.text: Arre, wahi jiske neeche kutta sota hai!
lines.say: अरे, वही जिसके नीचे कुत्ता सोता है!

lines.text: Kutta bhi roz jagah badalta hai, Tanya.
lines.say: कुत्ता भी रोज़ जगह बदलता है, तान्या।

lines.text: Shh! Ab Gupta ji ki chai ki dukaan se right.
lines.say: श्श! अब गुप्ता जी की चाय की दुकान से राइट।

lines.text: Chai ki dukaan? Yahan toh bank hai.
lines.say: चाय की दुकान? यहाँ तो बैंक है।

lines.text: Woh toh do saal pehle band ho gayi!
lines.say: वो तो दो साल पहले बंद हो गई!

lines.text: Haan toh? Bas Sharma ji ki laal gaadi ke peeche aa ja.
lines.say: हाँ तो? बस शर्मा जी की लाल गाड़ी के पीछे आ जा।

lines.text: Mil gayi! Peeche peeche aa rahi hoon.
lines.say: मिल गई! पीछे पीछे आ रही हूँ।

lines.text: Tanya... gaadi toh highway pe chadh gayi!
lines.say: तान्या... गाड़ी तो हाईवे पे चढ़ गई!

lines.text: Google bol raha hai... sirf do minute.
lines.say: गूगल बोल रहा है... सिर्फ़ दो मिनट।

lines.text: Do minute? Tanya ke saath ek ghanta!
lines.say: दो मिनट? तान्या के साथ एक घंटा!

lines.text: Dekha? Google se aati toh aur ghoomna padta!
lines.say: देखा? गूगल से आती तो और घूमना पड़ता!
